document.name: Bronx House Teen Basketball
document.shortDescription: Bronx House runs free teen basketball sessions for ages 13-18 on weeknights and weekends at its Pelham Parkway campus in the Bronx.
document.longDescription:
Bronx House lists Teen Basketball inside its Tweens & Teens program lineup for ages 13-18. The official page says these tween and teen programs are free and open through June 2026 thanks to support from the New York City Department of Youth & Community Development and United Neighborhood Houses.

The same official page publishes Teen Basketball on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 6:30 p.m. to 8:30 p.m., plus Saturdays and Sundays from 2:30 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. Bronx House describes the broader Teen Program as a place for ages 13-18 to learn, engage, and achieve through activities and classes.

Bronx House's official contact details list the site at 990 Pelham Parkway South, Bronx, NY 10461, with main phone 718.792.1800. The official about page also names the 5 train stop at Morris Park for access, which supports the canonical Morris Park neighborhood mapping used for this listing.

Sources: https://bronxhouse.org/tweens-teens/ https://bronxhouse.org/about/ https://bronxhouse.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/stony-brook-teens.jpg
